name: A Game For You, Josh
source:
This is a game about you, Josh.

Today is your birthday!!!

This is my present to you: a virtual tour of your house, with me, your best friend as your guide. We can reminisce about the good times, crack jokes, maybe even play a few games.

Either way it'll be tons of fun. Because it's your birthday, and you are my best friend in the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035260/]Steam[/url]]
